newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merged German bank to focus on core European mkt.
newsitem.headline: Merged German bank to focus on core European mkt.

text.p: Eberhard Martini, chief executive of Bayerische Hypothekenbank AG, which said earlier that it would merge with Bayerische Vereinsbank AG, said the new merged bank would concentrate on the core European market.

In the text of a speech prepared for delivery to a hastily- called news conference, Martini said that the new bank would focus on business with mid-sized firms, the retail sector and institutional customers.
Its core activities would be property financing and asset management, he added.
Acting to counter a likely wave of protest about the merger, Martini said the planned merger would preserve most jobs at the two banks and was the best solution on the jobs front.
"There will be fewer jobs lost than under any other solution as we both have ambitious expansion plans in Germany and Europe in particular," he said.
Banking sources said 5,000 to 7,000 jobs would be cut over the next five years as a result of the merger.
